# City of Orem

> > Official municipal website for Orem, Utah, providing city services, public safety, infrastructure management, and community resources.

The City of Orem serves residents with comprehensive municipal services including police and fire departments, building safety, public works, housing and zoning, and environmental programs. The site features Mayor's messages, service information, and community engagement opportunities.

## Key Topics

- City of Orem municipal services
- Orem Police Department (Orem PD)
- Public works and infrastructure
- Building safety and permits
- Storm water management
- Street sweeping and maintenance
- Housing and zoning regulations
- Mayor's messages and city updates
- Fire and EMS services
- Tree identification and urban forestry
- Community engagement programs
- NPDES and EPA compliance
- Wastewater pretreatment
- GRAMA records requests
- Utah Valley University (UVU) partnership

## Core City Services

- [Building Safety](https://orem.gov/buildingsafety): Building permits, inspections, and construction code compliance
- [Patrol Division](https://orem.gov/patrol-division): Police patrol services, K9 unit, SWAT team, and traffic enforcement
- [Housing](https://orem.gov/housing): Residential zoning, housing density, and General Plan information

## Public Works & Infrastructure

- [Storm Water Fees](https://orem.gov/storm-water-fees): Storm Sewer Utility fees and impervious surface billing information
- [Street Sweeping](https://orem.gov/sweeping): Street sweeping schedule and debris removal service information
- [Pavement Sidewalk Management](https://orem.gov/pavement-sidewalk-management): Infrastructure maintenance and asset management for streets and sidewalks
- [Pretreatment](https://orem.gov/pretreatment): Wastewater pretreatment program and NPDES compliance requirements

## Mayor's Updates

- [Mayor's Message: February 2025](https://orem.gov/mayors-message-february-2025): Mayor Young announces Citizen Connect platform for resident communication
- [Mayor's Message: January 2025](https://orem.gov/mayors-message-january-2025): Mayor Young outlines 2025 city goals and infrastructure projects
- [Mayor's Message: October 2025](https://orem.gov/mayors-message-october-2025): Mayor Young on local elections and voter participation in October 2025

## Tree Identification Guide

- [Bald Cypress](https://orem.gov/bald-cypress): Taxodium distichum tree identification and botanical profile
- [Western Catalpa](https://orem.gov/western-catalpa): Catalpa speciosa tree species identification and botanical guide
- [Green Ash](https://orem.gov/green-ash): Fraxinus pennsylvanica botanical profile and tree characteristics

## Records & Transparency

- [Fire and EMS Records](https://orem.gov/fire-and-ems-records): Fire and EMS records requests and annual reports via GRAMA

## Optional

- [Police Ride Along](https://orem.gov/product/police-ride-along): Orem PD ride-along auction item for community engagement experience
- [Guided Rock Walk with Aaron McKnight](https://orem.gov/product/guided-rock-walk-with-aaron-mcknight): Geology tour auction item at Hillcrest Center with Aaron McKnight
